verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own integration directory at linear.app/integrations, with dozens of listed apps (GitHub, Slack, Figma, Datadog, Salesforce, Notion, Fivetran, Airbyte and others). Third parties can submit agents to the directory, and admins can approve third-party apps before installation. Nothing in the evidence supports the 'thousands of tools' scale, and community reports say some workflows, such as email-to-ticket, still need Zapier or custom integrations. missing for 10: evidence of a marketplace at the scale of thousands of tools, independent hands-on corroboration of the marketplace install experience.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: To make your agent available to other workspaces, submit your agent to Linear's integration directory.
Third-party app approvals are now available on paid Linear plans, allowing admins to review and approve apps before they're installed.
